rules.title: Mass tolerance range
rules.source: Master Data All IMDS Project_new.xlsx, sheet Mass Check (TSZ2900), TSZ2900G Rev.9; G-CATS Error Type 7 workflow

calculation.toleranceLookup: Use Drawing Mass and the drawing's Mass Tolerance Class (MA, MB, MC, MD, ME, or MF) to look up the TSZ2900 tolerance.
calculation.coreRange: Min = Drawing Mass - tolerance; Max = Drawing Mass + tolerance.
calculation.screening: Compare IMDS mass against the additional buffer; missing/invalid class or mass returns HOLD / MANUAL_REVIEW.

requiredFields: supplierConfirmation A/B when outside the additional buffer

branches.when: IMDS mass is within the core TSZ2900 Min/Max range
branches.comment: Confirmed by Supplier: Actual or calculated mass.

branches.when: IMDS mass is outside the core range but within Min × 0.9 and Max × 1.1
IMDS mass is outside the additional 10% buffer and supplier confirms actual/calculated mass
IMDS mass is outside the additional 10% buffer and supplier confirms input mistake
raw material or missing/ambiguous drawing evidence
